objective.text: Use namespaced package views and application overrides without copying the entire package into application source.

difficulty.rationale: Resolve an application override without losing package defaults for other views.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: The provider calls loadViewsFrom(package_path, "billing"). Package views include receipt and footer. The application overrides only resources/views/vendor/billing/receipt.blade.php.

stem: Which templates render for view("billing::receipt") and view("billing::footer")?

options.text: Both application templates, with the receipt automatically reused for footer.
options.rationale: Each named view is resolved separately; one override is not reused for every name.
options.misconception: Each named view is resolved separately; one override is not reused for every name.

options.text: The application receipt and the package footer.
options.rationale: The application namespace override is checked first, while missing overrides fall back to package views.

options.text: The application receipt and a missing-view error for footer.
options.rationale: Overriding one view does not remove the package fallback for other views.
options.misconception: Overriding one view does not remove the package fallback for other views.

options.text: Both package templates, because a namespace bypasses application overrides.
options.rationale: loadViewsFrom registers the conventional application override path before the package path.
options.misconception: loadViewsFrom registers the conventional application override path before the package path.
